hubMetaTitle: K-3 Standards Checklists: Common Core and Texas TEKS by Grade
hubMetaDescription: Standards checklists for kindergarten through third grade: Common Core math and ELA and the Texas TEKS, each code with the lessons and worksheets we have for it.
hubTitle: Standards Checklists for Kindergarten Through Grade 3
hubLead: Each checklist covers one grade and one subject and lists the standards by their official codes. After each code you see what children do in our lessons, the lessons that teach it, and the worksheets that go with them. Codes we have nothing for are listed too, so you can see what is covered and what is not.
hubPageFacts: {taught} of {objectives} standards with lessons or worksheets
hubMissing: There is no checklist yet for Common Core ELA in second and third grade, for TEKS ELAR in kindergarten and third grade, or for science: our lessons cover too few of those standards for a checklist to be useful.
hubNote: These checklists are our own matching of lessons to the standards they name. They were not written, reviewed, or approved by the organizations that publish the standards.
